stem:
Fig. 4.1 shows the variation with time *t* of the height *h* above the ground of an object of mass 36 kg that is undergoing vertical simple harmonic motion.

[[fig:f1]]

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead: For the oscillations of the object:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: show that the angular frequency *ω* is 1.6 rad s⁻¹

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
On Fig. 4.2, sketch the variation with *h* of the kinetic energy *E*ₖ of the object.

[[fig:f2]]

figures.caption: Fig. 4.1
figures.alt: A height-versus-time graph oscillates between 2 cm and 18 cm, with peaks at 0, 4 and 8 seconds and troughs at 2 and 6 seconds.

figures.caption: Fig. 4.2
figures.alt: A blank graph grid has height h in cm on the horizontal axis from 0 to 20 and kinetic energy Eₖ in joules on the vertical axis from 0 to 0.4.
